method.method_draft: First describe the image: the noon solar altitude decreases in stage I, is lowest near stage II, and increases in stage III. From the text, leftward deflection identifies the place as in the Southern Hemisphere. Therefore the minimum in stage II corresponds to the Southern Hemisphere winter solstice. Stage III is the month after this minimum, when the Southern Hemisphere is moving away from winter solstice toward spring/summer. Since Sydney is also in the Southern Hemisphere, during stage III Sydney's daytime is increasing and nighttime is decreasing: 昼渐长夜渐短。
